summary: Grab Holdings Ltd (Grab) filed a Form 6-K announcing the completion of its acquisition of 100% equity in U.S. digital financial services company Stash Financial, Inc. (Stash). At closing on July 1, 2026, Grab paid for a 50.1% stake; the remaining interest will be paid at fair market value over three years post-closing. Terms such as total price, premium, and advisor names are not disclosed. The transaction is now closed, with deferred payments tied to future valuations. Watch for any post-closing disputes over earn-out valuation or integration risks.
